tasks.title: Implement User Authentication System
tasks.description: Add secure user authentication with sign-up, login, and session management using Convex Auth
tasks.details: Extend existing auth.config.ts to include proper OAuth providers (Apple Sign-In required for iOS, Google, email/password). Implement sign-up and login screens with proper form validation, password requirements, and error handling. Add protected routes and authentication state management. Integrate userId field that exists in schema into all database operations. Add biometric authentication support for iOS. Implement secure session management with proper token refresh.
tasks.testStrategy: Create unit tests for auth functions, integration tests for login/signup flows, test session persistence across app restarts, validate security requirements

tasks.title: Create Onboarding Flow
tasks.description: Design and implement first-run onboarding experience with welcome screens and habit creation tutorial
tasks.details: Create multi-screen onboarding flow with: welcome screen explaining app benefits, sample habit creation walkthrough using existing create habit functionality, tutorial overlay showing how to track habits using existing calendar interface, initial setup guidance for user preferences. Use react-native-paper components for consistent UI. Implement skip functionality and progress indicators. Store onboarding completion status in userSettings table.
tasks.testStrategy: Test onboarding flow completion, verify skip functionality, test tutorial interactions, validate first-time user experience

tasks.title: Add Privacy Policy and Terms of Service
tasks.description: Create and integrate privacy policy and terms of service for App Store compliance
tasks.details: Draft comprehensive privacy policy covering data collection, usage, and storage practices specific to habit tracking data. Create terms of service document outlining user responsibilities and app usage guidelines. Add legal screens accessible from settings. Implement mandatory acceptance flow during onboarding. Ensure GDPR and CCPA compliance. Host documents externally and link from app. Add data deletion and export capabilities.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify legal documents are accessible, test acceptance flow, validate external hosting, ensure compliance requirements are met

tasks.title: Implement Error Handling and Loading States
tasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling, loading states, and empty state designs throughout the app
tasks.details: Extend existing ErrorBoundary to handle more error types. Add loading skeletons for habit lists, tracking data, and statistics. Create empty state designs for: no habits created, no tracking data, network connectivity issues. Implement retry mechanisms for failed network requests. Add toast notifications using sonner for user feedback. Handle offline scenarios with appropriate messaging. Add error logging for debugging.
tasks.testStrategy: Test error scenarios, verify loading states appear correctly, validate empty state designs, test offline functionality, ensure error recovery works

tasks.title: Enhance Habit Management Features
tasks.description: Extend existing habit functionality with categories, editing, deletion, and reordering capabilities
tasks.details: Add habit editing functionality using existing updateNotes mutation as template. Implement habit deletion with confirmation dialog. Add drag-and-drop reordering using order field in schema. Create habit categories/tags system using existing tags field. Add habit search and filtering. Implement bulk actions for multiple habits. Add habit templates for quick creation. Enhance the existing habit creation form with category selection.
tasks.testStrategy: Test CRUD operations, verify reordering functionality, validate category system, test search and filtering, ensure data consistency

tasks.title: Implement Enhanced Statistics and Analytics
tasks.description: Expand existing statistics with more detailed analytics, charts, and insights
tasks.details: Extend existing getStats query to include monthly/yearly views, completion patterns, and trend analysis. Add chart components using react-native-chart-kit or similar. Implement habit insights like best performing days, streak analysis, and consistency trends. Add goal-setting functionality with progress tracking. Create summary dashboard with key metrics. Enhance existing streak calculation with more detailed breakdowns.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify statistical accuracy, test chart rendering, validate analytics calculations, ensure performance with large datasets

tasks.title: Build Settings and User Preferences
tasks.description: Expand existing SettingsDialog into comprehensive settings system with user preferences and account management
tasks.details: Extend existing userSettings schema and settings.ts functions with: timezone selection, week start day preference, theme/color customization options, accessibility settings (text size, high contrast), data retention preferences. Create comprehensive settings UI using existing SettingsDialog.tsx as base. Implement timezone-aware date calculations in existing habit queries. Add theme provider for consistent styling across the app.
tasks.testStrategy: Test settings persistence, verify timezone calculations, validate accessibility features, ensure theme consistency

tasks.title: Add Help System and Tutorials
tasks.description: Create in-app help system with contextual tutorials and FAQ section
tasks.details: Create help screens explaining habit tracking concepts, app features, and best practices. Add contextual help tooltips and tutorial overlays that can be triggered from any screen. Implement FAQ section with common questions. Add feature discovery system for new functionality. Create interactive tutorials for complex features. Add help accessibility through settings menu and floating help button.
tasks.testStrategy: Test help system navigation, verify tutorial completion, validate FAQ content, ensure help accessibility

tasks.title: Optimize Performance and Accessibility
tasks.description: Implement performance optimizations and accessibility features for App Store compliance
tasks.details: Add React.memo to habit components, optimize database queries using existing indexes, implement lazy loading for large habit lists. Add comprehensive accessibility labels, support for screen readers, keyboard navigation, and voice control. Implement proper semantic markup and ARIA labels. Add support for dynamic text sizing and high contrast modes. Optimize bundle size and startup time for iOS devices.
tasks.testStrategy: Performance testing with large datasets, accessibility testing with screen readers, validate compliance with iOS accessibility guidelines

tasks.title: Prepare iOS App Store Submission
tasks.description: Configure app metadata, icons, screenshots, and submission requirements for iOS App Store
tasks.details: Update app.json with final app metadata, bundle identifier, and version info. Create app icons for all required iOS sizes using existing design. Generate App Store screenshots for all device sizes showcasing key features. Configure EAS Build for production iOS builds. Set up App Store Connect listing with descriptions, keywords, and categories. Prepare app review notes highlighting key features. Configure push notification capabilities if needed. Test final build on physical iOS devices.
tasks.testStrategy: Validate app metadata, test production builds on multiple iOS devices, verify App Store requirements compliance, test submission process

tasks.title: Implement Social Authentication (Google & Apple Sign-in)
tasks.description: Add social sign-on capabilities using Google and Apple authentication providers integrated with Convex Auth
tasks.details: Install and configure @convex-dev/auth for social providers. Add Google OAuth configuration using expo-auth-session and @react-native-google-signin/google-signin. Implement Apple Sign-In using expo-apple-authentication. Update auth.config.ts to include Google and Apple providers. Create login/signup screens with social authentication buttons. Handle authentication state management and user profile creation. Ensure proper token handling and secure storage.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for authentication flows, integration tests for OAuth token exchange, manual testing on both iOS and Android devices, test error handling for failed authentications

tasks.title: Implement Local Push Notifications System
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive local notification system for habit reminders with customizable scheduling
tasks.details: Install expo-notifications and expo-device for notification handling. Create notification service using Expo's local notification API. Implement notification scheduling per habit with custom times. Add notification permission requests and settings management. Create notification content templates with habit-specific messaging. Implement notification categories and actions (mark complete, snooze). Add timezone support for accurate scheduling. Store notification preferences in Convex userSettings table with new fields: notificationsEnabled, habitReminders array.
tasks.testStrategy: Test notification scheduling accuracy, verify notifications work in background/foreground, test permission handling, validate timezone calculations, test notification actions

tasks.title: Build Advanced Analytics Dashboard with Calendar View
tasks.description: Create comprehensive analytics including calendar view, monthly/yearly statistics, and trend analysis
tasks.details: Install react-calendar for calendar component integration. Create analytics queries in Convex for monthly/yearly statistics. Implement streak history tracking with new database schema. Build calendar view component showing habit completion heat map. Create trend analysis algorithms for consistency patterns. Add completion rate graphs using react-native-chart-kit or victory-native. Implement data export functionality (CSV/JSON) using expo-sharing and expo-file-system. Create statistics screen with multiple view modes (weekly, monthly, yearly).
tasks.testStrategy: Test calendar performance with large datasets, verify statistics accuracy, test export functionality across platforms, validate chart rendering, test date range selections

tasks.title: Enhance Offline Support with Conflict Resolution
tasks.description: Implement robust offline functionality with advanced sync mechanisms and conflict resolution
tasks.details: Implement offline queue management using AsyncStorage or expo-sqlite. Create sync conflict resolution logic for concurrent habit updates. Add optimistic updates with rollback capability. Implement network state detection using @react-native-community/netinfo. Create offline indicator UI components. Add retry mechanisms for failed sync operations. Store offline actions with timestamps for conflict resolution. Update Convex mutations to handle conflict resolution with last-write-wins or user-choice strategies.
tasks.testStrategy: Test offline functionality without network, verify sync after reconnection, test conflict resolution scenarios, validate data consistency, test edge cases with rapid online/offline switching

tasks.title: Develop Social Sharing and Collaborative Features
tasks.description: Create social features for habit sharing, templates, and collaborative tracking
tasks.details: Design public habit templates system with Convex schema for shared habits. Implement friend connections with user relationship management. Create shared habit groups functionality with group progress tracking. Add social encouragement features (likes, comments, progress sharing). Implement privacy controls for habit visibility. Create template marketplace with categories and ratings. Add export/import functionality for habit templates. Implement sharing capabilities using expo-sharing for progress screenshots.
tasks.testStrategy: Test template creation and sharing, verify privacy controls, test group functionality with multiple users, validate social interactions, test sharing across platforms

tasks.title: Create Advanced Theme Customization System
tasks.description: Build comprehensive personalization options including themes, colors, and accessibility features
tasks.details: Implement theme provider using react-native-paper theming. Create custom color scheme editor with color picker components. Add timezone support using expo-localization and date-fns-tz. Implement week start day preferences in user settings. Create advanced accessibility options (font sizes, contrast modes, screen reader support). Add theme presets (light, dark, custom themes). Store personalization settings in Convex userSettings with new fields: customTheme, timezone, weekStartDay, accessibilitySettings.
tasks.testStrategy: Test theme switching in real-time, verify accessibility features with screen readers, test timezone calculations, validate color customization persistence, test across different device sizes

tasks.title: Build Habit Templates Library and Advanced Management
tasks.description: Create a comprehensive habit template system with drag-drop reordering and advanced settings
tasks.details: Create habit templates schema in Convex with categories, descriptions, and default settings. Implement drag-drop reordering using react-native-draggable-flatlist. Add advanced reminder settings with multiple daily notifications. Create habit goals and milestones tracking system. Implement habit difficulty levels with progress calculations. Add template categories (health, productivity, learning, etc.). Create habit template preview and customization interface. Add bulk habit creation from templates.
tasks.testStrategy: Test drag-drop functionality across devices, verify template creation and application, test advanced reminder scheduling, validate milestone tracking, test bulk operations

tasks.title: Implement Profile Management and Data Export
tasks.description: Create comprehensive user profile management with picture upload and data export capabilities
tasks.details: Implement profile picture upload using expo-image-picker and Convex file storage. Create profile management interface with editable user information. Implement account data export functionality (habits, tracking data, settings) in multiple formats (JSON, CSV). Add profile statistics dashboard. Create account deletion with data cleanup. Implement profile backup and restore functionality. Add profile sharing capabilities for social features.
tasks.testStrategy: Test image upload and storage, verify data export completeness and accuracy, test profile updates, validate account deletion cleanup, test backup/restore functionality

tasks.title: Create Community Features with Challenges and Leaderboards
tasks.description: Build community engagement features including public challenges, leaderboards, and friend connections
tasks.details: Create community challenges schema with participant tracking. Implement leaderboard system with various ranking criteria (streaks, consistency, participation). Build challenge creation and joining interface. Add friend invitation and connection system. Create community feed for shared progress and achievements. Implement challenge categories and difficulty levels. Add community moderation tools. Create achievement badges and rewards system.
tasks.testStrategy: Test challenge participation with multiple users, verify leaderboard accuracy, test friend connection flow, validate community feed updates, test moderation features

tasks.title: Optimize Performance and Add Advanced Analytics
tasks.description: Implement performance optimizations, caching strategies, and advanced user behavior analytics
tasks.details: Implement data caching strategies with React Query integration. Add performance monitoring using expo-analytics or similar. Create advanced user behavior tracking for app usage patterns. Implement lazy loading for large datasets. Add database query optimizations in Convex. Create performance monitoring dashboard. Implement automated testing for performance regression. Add crash reporting and error tracking using expo-dev-client or Sentry.
tasks.testStrategy: Performance testing with large datasets, memory usage monitoring, crash testing scenarios, analytics accuracy validation, cache effectiveness testing
